statement: For the exact rational signed witness category and one irreducible reduced Hodge branch T_red, find a source-specific proper/projective witness-incidence component whose image dominates T_red, without assuming class-level witness existence away from the central fibre or silently switching coefficient/category/component data.
generic_certificate: On verified smooth points of an appropriate source component and T_red, differential surjectivity may certify local dominance; proper closed image can then extend dense-open domination across the same irreducible reduced support.
falsifier: Reject any proposal that proves only detector vanishing, assumes the desired domination, works only on the full scheme tangent with no support-level implication, loses signed rational coefficients, uses a nonproper local incidence object for a closed-image argument, or imports special-family dimension identities without a transfer witness.
